free.question: Why is it free?
free.answer:
I created Shrink Me in order to compress my own images and pdf files in a fun and intuitive way.
I also love to create new product experiences in order to extend and refresh my developer knowledge.

why_compress.question: Why should I compress images/pdfs?
why_compress.answer:
Image/PDF compression is ideal if you want to make your site/app load faster, save storage space,
or even when sending emails, where smaller file sizes can help improve delivery and reduce loading times for recipients.

quality_loss.question: Do compressed images suffer from quality loss?
quality_loss.answer:
No, your images should look identical to the human eye.
You almost won't see any differences, just give it a try.

quality_setting.question: What Compression Quality is used for JPG and WEBP images?
quality_setting.answer:
Shrink Me's compression quality for JPG and WEBP images is 60%.
In the future, you will be able to change this value.

max_size.question: What is the maximum file size?
max_size.answer:
Currently there is no maximum file size limit.
Beware that big file sizes will take longer to compress.

multiple_files.question: Can I compress multiple files at once?
multiple_files.answer: Yes, you can shrink as many as you like at once.

not_smaller.question: Why didn't my image get any smaller?
not_smaller.answer: This may happen to images which already have been optimized.
